approval_tiers.draft: Drafted only. One named human must approve before anything opens.
approval_tiers.production: Affects production (line hold, setpoint change, spend above the threshold). Two different humans must approve (dual control).
approval_tiers.blocked: Always blocked. No agent may write to a PLC, with or without approval.

triggers: Production hold (request_line_hold): QA Lead and Shift Lead.
Process setpoint change (change_setpoint): Shift Lead and Maintenance Supervisor.
Purchase request above the spend threshold (mock USD): Buyer and Plant Manager.
Any gated tool without a named approver: Shift Lead and Plant Manager (fail closed).

plc_rule.rule: PLC writes are always blocked for every agent. No approval can unlock them.

fail_closed_rules: A tool outside the calling agent's lane is denied and logged.
A tool not in this policy fails closed as blocked.
Stale sensor or quality data stops the chain and escalates. Nothing is drafted.
Systems of record that disagree (for example Maximo-style EAM vs SAP-style ERP) stop the chain, hold any draft and escalate.
An unparseable spend amount is treated as above the threshold.
An approval that times out expires. It needs a fresh request.
If this policy is unsigned, or its fingerprint does not match the signed fingerprint, agents may read only. Drafts and production actions are blocked.

scenarios.proves: Agents hand work to each other; nothing opens without the named human.
Maximo-style EAM and SAP-style ERP disagree: stop, hold, escalate.
A production hold needs QA Lead and Shift Lead. PLC write blocked.
Every out-of-lane attempt is denied and logged.
Stale data is not routed into a work order.
A policy edited after sign-off blocks drafts and production actions. Reads still run.

signoff.note: Leadership signs the SHA-256 fingerprint of this policy with the signoff block removed. Any later edit changes the fingerprint and blocks drafts and production actions until it is signed again.
